item.title: MAME4iOS v2022.5
item.description:
MAME4iOS 2022.5 | MAME4iOS-2022.5-139
* Updated to [MAME 250](https://www.mamedev.org/releases/whatsnew_0250.txt). * tvOS UX: use a Alert instead of a inline Segmented Control. * Show upload feedback in Web Server UX. * Added `Make First Favorite` to game context menu.
